Hi Elena — thanks for the clear ask and timeline. Attaching our latest Type II for 2024 and a formal bridge letter dated 2025-06-01 that covers service continuity from 2024-07-01 through 2025-06-30.

Short answers:
- We can provide the redacted Type II (attached).
- We can issue a signed bridge letter suitable for procurement and legal. We typically sign bridge letters on company letterhead and can also execute via DocuSign if you prefer.
- We accept DocuSigned bridge letters to be attached to the PO.

Two operational notes / asks from our side:
1) Bridge wording: please confirm whether Starlite needs the bridge to state explicit coverage dates and auditor name, or if a high-level attestation is sufficient. We can include auditor and control scope if required, but that may require minimal legal review.
2) Invoices: if the PO requires net-60 payment terms that materially delay invoice acceptance, we request a PO clause that disclaims suspension of service during the bridge period; otherwise we may need to align invoicing cadence to ensure no gap in entitlements.

Next steps I recommend:
- Laura (CS lead) to confirm bridge wording acceptable to Redwood and escalate any redlines.
- Naomi (security/compliance) to confirm the redacted Type II and the bridge PDF meet your audit requirements.

Elena — if you confirm DocuSign is preferred I will send the bridge via DocuSign today; otherwise I can also send a signed PDF.

We do need the bridge to explicitly state: auditor name (Brightgate LLP), audit period covered (2023-07-01 to 2024-06-30), and an attestation that controls remained in place through 2025-06-01. That wording will satisfy our internal auditors.
